passages.text: The third area covers battery recycling and failure diagnostics. The institute states that this research evaluates practical recycling processes and post-mortem protocols that can improve material recovery, produce more consistent failure data and support battery-lifecycle decisions. Research scientist Devashish Salpekar will present “Multi-Use of Salt Solutions in the Recycling of Lithium-Ion Cylindrical and Pouch Cells,” describing the reuse of salt solutions across recycling of cylindrical and pouch cell formats. Research scientist Frederick Gray will present “Impact of Electrode Washing Protocols on Post-Mortem Diagnostics for Lithium-Ion Battery Failure Analysis,” addressing how electrode washing procedures affect the quality of post-mortem failure analysis.
